title: The kb-worker brief says how to run an item's repro
goal: Retrospective of SP-wgx4pq4r: BG-ot6xthfk's worker found no rule in the kb-worker set for running an item's repro (backlog.py has no repro command) and ran it from the item file's repro.run list by hand. The kb-worker set and .claude/agents/kb-worker.md name the command that runs an item's repro and checks (backlog.py goal prints them; done runs them), the set's eval rows pass, and selfdoc check passes.
